notes: Taiwan bundles combine the DGBAS 2020 Population & Housing Census (主計總處人口及住宅普查) tables with the DGBAS Minimum Statistical Area (最小統計區) polygon population field for within-village (里) population weighting at the sub-村里 census-cell level. For distributing jobs, a 14-class Non-Negative Least-Squares (NNLS) workplace-classification model disaggregates the 2021 Industry & Services Census (110年工商業普查) per-township industry totals onto a 100m mesh, with the NLSC 國土利用調查 (NLUI) Level-2 raster providing land-use class and NLSC LoD1 buildings (內政部國土測繪中心 3D 精緻建物模型) providing per-building height and floor count for the volume signal. Administrative boundaries come from the MOI 村里界圖 (VILLAGE_NLSC). For resident-worker flows, the DGBAS census provides per-county and per-township workplace × residence O/D matrices; a gravity model with distance-decay distributes commutes among point pairs while a cordon-snap pass injects cross-bundle commute mass from neighbouring counties as anchored sinks at county centroids, and a Generalized IPF (GIPF) pass pins each township's self-loop share to the per-township census ground truth.
